title: Cache
description: Live hit/miss and key stats for the cache; invalidate specific or all known keys below if you have manage access.
disabledDescription: Pass a @gnldev/cache-backed store (implementing stats()) as the `cache` option to createStudioApi to enable this view.
knownKeysHint: no enumeration — only what this instance has seen
emptyStats: No hits/misses yet — cache is waiting to be used.
keyHelp: Leave empty to clear all known keys.
confirmDescKey: This key will be removed from the cache; the next request recomputes it.
confirmDescAll: Since the store doesn't support key enumeration, this ONLY covers the keys the host cache instance has KNOWN about during this process — the entire store may not be guaranteed to be cleared.
